title: Self-reinforced geometric absorption: code, data pipeline and generated results
description:
Analysis code, likelihood implementations, simulation code, test suite and generated results for the manuscript Self-reinforced geometric absorption. No observational data are redistributed: a script downloads each public data set and verifies its checksum. Nested-sampling chains are not archived; the summarised posteriors, evidences, profiles and every number quoted in the manuscript are.

Every figure and every number in the manuscript is generated by this code: make reproduce-core rebuilds everything except the sampler runs in about twenty-five minutes, and make reproduce-full rebuilds those too.
